items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: And Fat and I were working in the same place, just working.

ctx.x: How many, how big were the bands?

Two of them small bands, like four or five people. Yeah. And Fat and I were working in the same place, just working. Yeah. And one night, fella come through there, I wasn't working. I'd say I'd probably been just as lucky as Fat, you know, if I'd been there. And made Fat been made ever since.
